interfaces.name: neck_horn
interfaces.what: D17.0 x 1.0 raised disc on a D16.9 x 2.3 plate at the front-top corner, carrying the XL330 horn relief pocket and 4 x D2.2 on a D12 PCD (holes at y/z offsets (+6,0)(-6,0)(0,+6)(0,-6) from (-22,50)) - the neck-pitch joint axis (MJCF neck_pitch at world y=14.5) runs along +x through this face
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's right_shell.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders and meshslice.loops, 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: base_screw
interfaces.what: D8 vertical boss at the front-outboard corner: D2.2 pilot z 40.58..42.5 tapped by an M2 driven from below, D5.06 driver-access bore continuing up through the top skin
interfaces.source: MEASURED: meshfeatures hole D2.2 axis -z at (-25.5,-9.5,41.53) len 1.94; bore and boss mirrored-identical to the left shell's (outer hulls match to 0.01 mm)

interfaces.name: cross_screw
interfaces.what: the tapped side of the cross screw that closes the two halves: D1.6 pilot x -0.3..-5.0 (M2 self-tapping), drafted D3.0..4.0 bore continuing to the outboard wall; the left shell provides the D2.2 clearance and the 1.0 mm lap strip that registers the halves (the right has no lap - its bbox ends at the midplane x=0)
interfaces.source: MEASURED: meshfeatures hole D1.6 at (-2.65,42,52.5) len 4.7; bore taper from z@42 spans at x=6..27 (mirrored frame)

interfaces.name: base_ledge
interfaces.what: the 2.25 mm foot at the back-bottom (|x| 20..28.6, y 23..44, bottom z = 17.23 + 0.04|x|) that the shell stands on inside the trunk; the mating part is not identified (CANNOT DETERMINE which trunk part it rests on - needs the assembled MJCF clearance check)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off the z=19.2 plan cut and z-intervals (mirrored into the left frame), 2026-09-02
